messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Shopping and Retail" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your Order with Amazon.com Thanks for your order, richard.clayton@highwayman.com', 'If this sign up was made by someone else, and you want to unsubscribe, click on the link under the subscription options in this message, and then change the password on your profile, supposedly it was stolen.', 'After this period, the required sum will be debited from your default payment option and the subscription will be activated.', 'Furthermore, find as attached our urgent order for your esteemed company.', 'Thanks for your order, postmaster@highwayman.com', 'Order # MXDTT6680Y in Iphone 5S - Thanks For Purchase.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
